title: Switch areas
intro: Which seats each switch serves: pinned here, learned from the seats mapped to its ports (seat walk, check-in, patch plan), or from where the switch is drawn on the plan. Where they disagree it says so here. A check-in that has to ask the switches asks the seat's own switches first.

drift.learned_outside_plan: Learned outside the block it is drawn in: {{seats}}
drift.excluded_learned: Left out, but seats are learned on it: {{seats}}

todoCount_one: {{count}} switch serves no seats yet: pin it, draw it in its block, or walk its seats.
todoCount_other: {{count}} switches serve no seats yet: pin them, draw them in their block, or walk their seats.
todo: Not drawn in a block and no seats learned
editHint: A pin wins over what was learned and where the switch is drawn. Seats learned outside the pin are still shown.
excludeHint: For distribution and core switches that serve no seats.
noneHint: Switches come from the inventory (NetBox, discovery or by hand).

found.pin: {{switch}} is pinned to {{area}}; this seat is in {{row}}.
found.plan: {{switch}} is drawn in {{area}}; this seat is in {{row}}.
found.excluded: {{switch}} is excluded from serving seats; this seat ({{row}}) is on it.
